prompt: doxygen \image command inline option caption behavior HTML
answer: Use the option in braces, with no space between `\image` and `{inline}`: ```text \image{inline} html image.png "caption" ``` The syntax is: ```text \image['{'option[,option]'}'] ["caption"] [=] ``` For HTML, `inline` places the image in the text line. Its caption is **not displayed below the image**; instead, it is emitted as the image’s HTML tooltip (`title` attribute). For example, the generated HTML may look like: ```html ``` The caption must be quoted, even when it contains no spaces.
